title.narrative: Measles vaccination campaign in Hayran District, Hajjah Governorate

description.narrative: Eliminating measles in the northwestern regions of Hajjah Governorate by vaccinating children under 18 years of age and identifying and counting pregnancy cases in the region

The project is based on the idea of ​​comprehensive immunization of children under 18 years against measles. During this campaign, children will be vaccinated against measles through 8 fixed centers and also by 7 mobile teams to cover all districts in the north of Hajjah Governorate (Midi, Hayran, Abs, Haradh) in addition to Razih District in Hajjah Governorate. King Salman Humanitarian Aid and Relief Center will provide vaccines and fully fund the campaign. During this campaign, the number of pregnant women in the above-mentioned areas will be monitored and counted to provide reliable data that enables good planning of health services and more accurate identification of needs. This will be accompanied by an awareness campaign on the importance of the vaccine and the risks of measles during the campaign period, which will last for a full month.

Vaccinating 95% of children under 18 years of age against measles across the northwestern areas of Hajjah Governorate and Razih District in Saada Governorate. Raising awareness of the risks of measles and the importance of vaccination among all residents in Hajjah Governorate. A statistical database of the number of pregnant and lactating women and newborns in the areas included in the project.
